sources.snippet: Erawan 1 Erawan 1 is a 1.7B-parameter language model fine-tuned for reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, developed by Airavat AI Micro Lab. Built on Qwen3-1.7B, fine-tuned with QLoRA and merged into a standalone full-precision checkpoint.
